messages.subject: Bugs in openCR
parts: When bugs turn up I fix them as soon as I can, but there will usually be a delay before the clean version is released. To ease my conscience I've added a section on 'Known bugs' to the web page. Bugs will be deleted from there once the fix has filtered through to CRAN - usually within a month or two.
